FBI removes Accenture contractor for alleged involvement in a data breach that exposed details of thousands of employees

The Federal Bureau of Investigation removed an Accenture contractor on Monday over their role in a damaging data breach that exposed sensitive personal details of thousands of bureau employees, two sources familiar with the matter told Reuters.
